text: Become anything: tap a creature with no spell in hand and press Become. If it walks, you see through its eyes and the rest of the page steps aside: drag to look, the stick at the bottom left walks it, and its own acts and magic are buttons at the bottom right. A villager does its trade on what is in front: Fell, Fish, Harvest, Build. Pick any of your spells from the bar at the bottom and cast it where the mark points, up to 14 steps away. The eye button takes you behind it. Leave the World tab and you are still that creature when you come back; Let go gives it back its own mind.
